items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: "The Heavens are Telling’ by Ludwig von Beethoven"

ctx.x: And you’d been playing clarinet for a few years.

About four years, three or four years. I don’t remember how serious it was, but I remember playing, you know with the piano playing the “Twelve Street Rag” at an assembly period. “Now we’ll see ‘The Heavens are Telling’ by Ludwig von Beethoven to be followed by John Kenneth Davern performing on the clarinet “The Twelfth Street Rag.” And I remember how awful it was trying to finger the Albert System playing because [scats] I got messed up. So yeah, when I went to high school I was lucky to go out of the…
